links.outcome: Clinician concerns about deskilling from medical AI use, from interviews
links.effect: Participants mentioned deskilling as a concern about medical AI, alongside workflow distortion, alert fatigue, and unsophisticated algorithms. No frequency was reported in the abstract.
links.quote: While the participants expressed expectations that medical AI could enhance their patients' outcomes, increase work efficiency, and reduce hospital operating costs, they also mentioned concerns regarding distortions in the workflow, deskilling, alert fatigue, and unsophisticated algorithms.

links.outcome: Clinician concerns about alert fatigue from medical AI in ER/ICU settings
links.effect: Participants raised alert fatigue as a concern about medical AI. The authors highlighted alert fatigue management as important. No frequency was reported in the abstract.
links.quote: They also highlighted the importance of alert fatigue management and the integration of AI systems into the workflow.

screen.reason: Qualitative interview study exploring clinician expectations, concerns, and implementation strategies regarding medical AI in critical care settings.
